name: StudEx — Agent Loops (4h vault sync, 6h signal, 24h proposal)

nodes.name: Every 4 Hours
nodes.notes: Vault sync. Cheap and boring, and the reason nothing is ever lost.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'vault sync ' + new Date().toISOString(), sign: true, push_to: 'gitea' }) }}

nodes.name: Commit And Push Vault
nodes.notes: Signed commit to the client's own private Gitea repository.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ author: 'chief-of-staff', text: 'Vault synced. ' + ($json.files_changed ?? 0) + ' notes committed.' }) }}

nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Signal loop. READ ONLY. Observations with counts, no recommendations.

nodes.name: Collect Signals
nodes.notes: Read-only collection. This node must never have write scope on any connected account.

nodes.name: Every 24 Hours
nodes.notes: Proposal loop. Produces proposals for #approvals. Never acts.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ author: 'research', requires_approval: true, text: 'Daily proposals (' + $json.proposal_count + '). Each needs a named human decision.', proposals: $json.proposals }) }}

nodes.name: Post Proposals To Approvals
nodes.notes: Posts to #approvals, never to a customer. The loop ends at a human decision.

nodes.name: Nothing Above Threshold
nodes.notes: A quiet day is a valid outcome. Do not manufacture proposals to fill the slot.
